newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CITY HOTELS BUYS FOURTH HOTEL IN U.S..
newsitem.headline: CITY HOTELS BUYS FOURTH HOTEL IN U.S..

text.p: City Hotels USA has bought the Grandview Hotel in Tusla, Oklahoma, for $9.2 million, parent company City Hotels said in a statement on Tuesday.
City Hotels would invest $4.7 million to renovate the hotel before turning it into a franchised 290-room Hilton.
The Grandview is the fourth U.S. hotel bought by City Hotels since January 1997. The U.S. is now the company's first market.
The others are in Detroit, Orlando and Dayton. The group also has hotels in Chantilly, Brussels, Ostend and Amsterdam.
In 1996 the Grandview had profits of $3.2 million, with a room occupation rate of 48.3 percent and an exploitation cashflow of $197,000.

After the refurbishing and the incorporation in the Hilton worldwide network City Hotels USA expects profits of $7.7 million from the Grandview, a room occupation rate of 69 percent and exploitation cashflow of $2.3 million.
